nom: MEDITHERAPY Hyaluronic Acid Serum 5.07 fl oz

avis.texte: This simple product has changed my skin drastically! I’m not great at skincare or using anything consistently, but this has been so easy to use. I apply two pumps each morning and night and was just asked my several ladies at church what my secret is because I look 50 years younger (I’m only 42!) and this is the only thing I’ve changed in my skincare routine! My skin has become more supple, less wrinkly, my hyperpigmentation dark spots are fading, and my pores are shrinking. Super effective and great value! Add to cart and buy now!!

This stuff is great. I have auto immune and thyroid issues so everything is so dry my hair, my eyes, my skin. To the point where I’m flaking, even though I exfoliate and put lotions on and stuff. But I have several cats and there is hair everywhere so I hate putting much on my face because the hair stick to my face before I know it and I’m fighting cat hair all over my face. What I really love about this it’s almost like water is clear and it goes on and soaks in immediately and doesn’t leave any residue. I’ve been using it for maybe a week and I absolutely love it. My skin is so moisturizing.

Excellent bottle size. I have sensitive skin so I tried it on the back of my hand. I use it on my face to help my dry skin. It’s helpful non greasy. No skin breakout. I don’t put anything on my face, like makeup or other products, but I do like this product. I would buy this again.

This serum is the BOMB!! My skin feels incredibly smooth ,well hydrated and dewy. I love it. I use it on my face neck and upper chest area. It really helps with the dryness I have due to age. The bottle is very large considering most of these serums are in a itty bitty bottles. I will defiantly be reordering this!!
It’s light weight and hasn’t irritated my rosacea prone skin even during flare ups putting it on is super easy and my face feels amazing and looks great even with a full on Rosacea flare.

I have this serum on subscription, use it everyday and love it. I also use the retinal skin booster from same brand and love it. Game changer in skin texture, zero irritation. Very slight tackiness that goes away when it dries. I have sensitive skin especially around my eyes and this causes no reactions. Can’t beat the price for Korean skin care. Customer completely satisfied!

avis.titre: A must have for morning, and night use on hands, face, legs!
avis.texte: Is hard to believe something this good is on the market. I bought this Hyaluronic Acid Serum for dry skin, cannot believe what a difference it makes. I ordered a couple of more just to have in hand. I love that does not cause skin irritation, is non greasy, helps with fine lines, and my skin glow.
It very greasy looking once on. I guess that’s the glow they are describing. It just look greasy. When applied to arms and body. It has a tacky feel. Not impressed. I don’t think I will be reordering
I love it! Goes on very easily and leaves skin smooth. Very handy pump dispenser

Seit einigen Wochen in Benutzung und Wow!, ein toller Toner, der sich als Serum nutzbar ist. Ich verwende ihn als Toner und es ist quasi wie Wasser. Für Mischhaut ein absolut toller Artikel und gibt unglaublich viel Feuchtigkeit!
I have been using if for a month now and its making a huge difference in my face. My skin feels hydrated clear and smooth. Best purchases can’t wait to buy it again once i finish it.

I was previously using the ordinary hyaluronic acid but I will stick to this from now on, great value for money. Absorbs in the skin well and has great moisturising effect. Also helpful tips on the bottle to ensure you get maximum hydration. No skin irritation and I've been using for 10 days now and the bottle is only about 2cm down from the top, it's going to last ages! You get a lot in it and I definitely notice a difference from using it. Very effective Hyaluronic acid.

I ordered "MEDITHERAPY Vitamin Skin Booster Bubble Serum – Non-Irritating Gentle Daily Brightening with 2% Vitamin C Derivative – Deep Absorbing Micro-Bubble Formula – No-Sting, Non-Sticky AM/PM Use – 100ml". This serum is made in China and as of February 2026 it sells for just under $28, which feels like a fair price for what you get. What sets this serum apart from others I’ve tried is the foam—or “micro-bubble”—texture. It’s incredibly light, absorbs almost instantly, and leaves no sticky or tacky residue. Some serums I use can take 10–15 minutes to fully settle, but this one disappears on contact, which makes it my go-to for morning routines under makeup. It feels like it’s quietly doing its job in the background without interfering with the rest of my skincare or cosmetics. I haven’t noticed a dramatic brightening effect yet, but the ease of use and lightweight texture make it a pleasure to apply. The bottle is a decent size, though the pump is necessarily a bit larger to handle the foam, so it takes up more space than a traditional liquid serum. The scent is mild and refreshing—not overpowering—and it disappears quickly, so it’s fine even for those sensitive to strong fragrances. A non-scented option would probably be appreciated by more users. The foam makes it easier to target areas like the tops of the hands or chest, which can be awkward with a traditional liquid serum. Overall, I think this is a clever, well-thought-out product that delivers good value. For the pri

There is no discernible fragrance added to this toner, so if you’re looking for something fragrance-free you’ll like this one. Besides that, I like the dripless pump for dispensing the lotion. You can measure out exactly how much you need, unlike with bottles that pour. The product listing states that this is non-sticky, “zero stickiness”, but that’s only after it completely absorbs in. It contains hyaluronic acid, an ingredient that is inherently “sticky”. So, yes, when you first apply it there will be a slight tacky feeling. It goes away after a while. How long it takes depends on your own skin. For me, the tackiness is gone on some parts of my face faster than on others, taking longer under the eyes. So far I haven’t seen dramatic results but my skin has been drier than usual lately. I’ll continue using this hyaluronic acid serum and hop that there’s some improvement down the road. This serum doesn’t have as many “natural” ingredients as I’d like, but I’m happy that it’s fragrance-free. It’s a bit more expensive than some similar products, but still fairly reasonably priced.

avis.titre: Great non-scented skin booster, with no irritation!
avis.texte: This review is for the MEDITHERAPY Vitamin Skin Booster Bubble Serum – Non-Irritating Gentle Daily Brightening Real Vitamin C. I’ve been using this for over week now and like how this feels on my skin. I have an extensive skincare routine already but incorporated this into it with no issues or irritation at all. It comes out as foam but once you rub your hands, it liquifies and glides on well. I do see that it brightens my skin but since I’ve only used it for a week or so, can’t say that’s it’s shown a huge difference yet but can see a spot lightening up in my face. It doesn’t seem to be a scent to it either. Overall, I find this skin booster serum, non-irritating as described and feel refreshed using this, along with seeing a shine to my skin and slightly brighter.
Customer service was great with helping me with this product however, I found it to leave a very sticky film

I’ll start with the biggest surprise for me: the scent. This serum has a strong minty scent, which I personally really dislike, so that was an immediate negative. The scent is noticeable at application, though it does fade fairly quickly. I eventually got used to it, but I do wish it were fragrance-free or at least less mint-forward. The pump took a few tries to fully prime, but once it got going, it dispensed a very fine, airy foam. I actually really like the micro-bubble texture, it spreads easily and makes application feel lightweight and even. One pump is more than enough for my needs, so the 100ml bottle should last a good while. Before applying it to my face, I tested it on my arms and legs and didn’t experience any irritation. On my skin, it absorbed quickly, didn’t feel sticky, and didn’t cause any stinging. I’ve used Vitamin C products before, so my skin is somewhat accustomed to them, but I appreciated that this formula felt gentle. At $27.99, I think this is a fair value for the amount of product you receive and the performance. If you’re sensitive to scent (especially mint) that’s something to keep in mind, but overall it’s a solid, easy-to-use Vitamin C option.

avis.titre: Nice quality, skin feels plump and hydrated!
avis.texte: Great quality! I absolutely love this product! The serum is lightweight and it doesn’t feel too sticky and heavy or make your face greasy and weighted down with oil! It’s unscented and I love the light blue coloring, the design of the bottle and the large 5 oz. sizing! Great value overall! After properly cleansing my face, this product blended into my skin effortlessly and gave it a nice glow without any adverse effects or irritation! I then added a layer of my favorite everyday name brand moisturizer and eye cream and voila, my skin felt soft, hydrated and plump! It actually works just as good (if not better) as my usual name brand serum that I use in my skin care routine! It doesn’t take much product to moisturize so this large bottle will last me a long time. I always experience a drier t-zone area in the cooler seasons, specifically around the cheeks and chin areas of my face. After my night time routine, when I woke the next day, my face still felt smooth and moisturized! Hands down, this serum is now a permanent staple in my routine and I’d love to explore the whole line of skincare from this brand! Great addition to my epidermis, glad to have it!☺️

The Meditherapy Hyaluronic Acid Serum XXL arrived quickly and I was pleasantly surprised of its size. I often fail to check the amount of something, but here it came in a 5.07 fl oz, which is a really good amount, and it will last me for a while. I love how the serum feels on my skin, smoothing out any bumps, and it is not overly shiny like other Hyaluronic acid-based serums I’ve tried before. It also feels natural, and it doesn’t leave a thick layer like other serums or even face washes. This is one of my biggest annoyances with skin care serums, washers, and creams, when afterwards you feel like you are wearing a thick coat of paint. My skin seems to respond really well to these ingredients, and it is helping to alleviate my pores and helping my skin feel more hydrated. This is what helps some of my minor acne scars get hydrated and not feel so dry. Overall, my skin has enjoyed it, and it is helping my skin feel clean and fresh every day.

This hyaluronic acid serum is so good! The texture is super light and watery, so it absorbs really fast without feeling sticky or heavy. My skin drinks it up right away and feels instantly softer and more hydrated. I love that it adds that “plump” feeling without any greasiness, and it makes my skin look smoother and more refreshed right after applying. What I really like is that it gives deep hydration that actually lasts. My skin usually gets dry again a few hours after using other toners, but this one keeps it feeling moisturized all day. It also layers really well under moisturizer or makeup it helps my foundation go on smoother and look way more natural. The bottle size is super generous, which makes it easy to use it daily and even layer it a couple times when my skin needs extra moisture. Overall, it’s perfect if you want a hydrating serum that feels light but gives lasting moisture to the skin! This would also make a great gift for someone who is really into Korean skincare or skincare in general!

avis.titre: Lightweight Hydrating Serum That Keeps My Skin Soft and Plump All Day
avis.texte: The Meditherapy Hyaluronic Acid Serum XXL has been such a nice addition to my skincare routine. The texture is very lightweight and watery so it absorbs fast without leaving any sticky or heavy feeling on my skin. It gives that fresh hydrated look right away and keeps my skin feeling soft and plump throughout the day. The large 150 ml bottle is generous and just a few drops go a long way making it an excellent value for the size. My skin looks smoother and feels more balanced, especially in dry weather or after cleansing. It’s also completely free of added fragrances and colorants which I really appreciate since I have sensitive skin. The formula feels clean, gentle and non-irritating. It layers easily under moisturizer, makeup and sunscreen. Everything about it feels simple, effective and comfortable to use daily. Overall it’s a great hydrating serum that gives lasting moisture and that healthy glow I like. Thank so much for reading my review :-)

avis.titre: Lightweight Vitamin C Bubble Serum, Gentle and Non-Irritating
avis.texte: This product is interesting because even though it’s called a serum, it doesn’t feel like a traditional serum at all. It comes out as tiny bubbles, almost like soap bubbles, but it’s not soapy in texture or feel. It’s extremely lightweight, spreads easily, and absorbs very quickly into the skin. There was no stinging or burning at all, which is impressive for a vitamin C product, and it didn’t leave any sticky or greasy residue. I used this on both my face and neck, and it was gentle enough for my neck as well, which is often more sensitive. My skin looked more hydrated right after application and felt comfortable, not tight or irritated. I can’t speak to long-term brightening yet since I haven’t used it long enough, but as a daily, gentle vitamin C product for sensitive skin, it’s been a pleasant experience so far.

This is a review of an item ordered through the Vine program. Contrary to popular opinion, these items are often not free, as we pay taxes on the value of items. This means I review items that I actually want/need. Item: MEDITHERAPY Vitamin Skin Booster Bubble Serum – Non-Irritating Gentle Daily Brightening with 2% Vitamin C Derivative – Deep Absorbing Micro-Bubble Formula – No-Sting, Non-Sticky AM/PM Use – 100ml This serum is foamy and lightweight. Contains vitamin C for skin brightening. I found it to be quickly absorbed and non-sticky, as advertised. It did not irritate my sensitive skin. It contains these risky ingredients: methyl gluceth-20, glycereth-26, and disodium EDTA, all of which are low risk. Overall, excellent choice.

avis.titre: Need to apply 3 times for maximum effectiveness. (per box instructions)
avis.texte: I really wanted to give this 3.5 stars, but that isn't an option. I like this, but it only has 2% vitamin C in it. It is a foam, which is new for me. So I don't hate it but I didn't love it either. It tells you to apply multiple layers, and I don't like having to do extra steps in an already multi-step routine. They said it was to absorb better and be more effective. I currently use a 5% vitamin C serum, which take less work to get it on my face effectively. It does say you can apply to other parts of your body, so I used it on my arms. And liked it really well for that. It absorbs rather quickly. Didn't have a scent and didn't sting when I used it, however, since I already use a 5% Vit C product daily, I didn't expect it to. So if you are new to using Vit C, then you may feel a slight tingle, as you should. Since it is shelf stable, and doesn't have to be refrigerated, I think this will travel well. My 5% Vit C has to be refrigerated, so I don't travel with it. (just lazy on my part) At the time of this review, the price point for this item is$27.99 or $8.28/fl oz. In my opinion, this is on the higher side compared to what I pay for my 5% Vit C.

avis.titre: Works very well and absorbs quickly
avis.texte: This is a brand from Korea known for their beauty products. I'm in my 70's, so need all the help I can get to keep my skin somewhat elastic. At my age I'm not going to have a "glowy" skin, so I wasn't expecting that. I use it after I shower in the evening, and it absorbs very quickly into my skin, leaving it feeling nourished. One pump of the foam does my entire face as well as my neck. I don't normally moisturize my face before putting a primer on in the morning, but I have just started doing that with this serum, as I find that it really does make a difference. My primer goes on very smoothly. Probably because the serum absorbs quickly without any greasy feel. A nice large bottle for a reasonable price with a serum that works very well. You can't help but love it!

avis.titre: Awesome! Great choice for Korean 7-skin method
avis.texte: This is a simple product that does one job and does it really well! It’s a hydrating hyaluronic acid toner serum and I love it. I have dry sensitive rosacea skin and use the K-beauty method of applying multiple very thin layers for this toner serum and it works so well to hydrate and calm my skin. If you have dry skin, I would totally recommend using a hydrating toner, you won’t regret it. This serum dries quick, isn’t sticky and doesn’t pill. I use it under my vit C in the AM and under my retinol in the PM. I love that it’s fragrance free and has a clean and fairly simple ingredient list. The tamper evident box is easily bypassed, so I wish it had a better type of seal, but it does have a clear expiration date. Company transparency checks out too (always research your online skincare purchases!). This isn’t going to give you bam-pow overnight results, but the extra hydration really does make a big difference over time. Plus it’s huge for the price, so you can use it on your neck and decollete too. It’s my go-to hyaluronic acid serum now and I would definitely recommend it.

I’ve been using the Meditherapy Hyaluronic Acid Serum XXL and overall I’m pleased with the results. The first thing that stood out to me was the size and value- 150ml is incredibly generous for a serum especially at this price point. It feels like it will last a long time which makes it a great deal compared to smaller bottles from other brands. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue which I really appreciate. It layers beautifully under moisturizer and makeup, keeping my skin hydrated throughout the day. My skin looks noticeably plumper and more radiant, especially in the mornings. It gives that healthy, glass-skin glow that Korean skincare is known for. The serum has a very subtle, clean scent, nothing overwhelming, which is nice for daily use. I also like that it feels gentle and hasn’t caused any irritation or breakouts, even with my somewhat sensitive skin. Yet while it’s deeply hydrating, it doesn’t quite deliver on the anti-aging or wrinkle care claims as dramatically as I hoped, at least not yet. Still for hydration and overall skin smoothness, it performs beautifully and feels like a smart, budget-friendly addition to my routine.

I was very close to giving this a 3 star review but I’m glad I gave it more time before judging it. As someone regrettably close to 40, I’ve been spending more time overhauling my skincare routine to meet changing needs. I love hyaluronic acid, my skin has loved almost everything I’ve tried with it so I had high hopes for this. Despite seeing the product information beforehand, I was still surprised how big the is. Even with applying a couple pumps daily, it’s going to last. The price is reasonable too. I haven’t done the cost per use math but considering this is cheaper than some of my other HA products in a larger size, it’s going to come out as one of the more economical options in the routine. The serum itself is not very exciting. It’s clear and odorless with a light stickiness. To be fair, the stickiness is almost not existent after it’s applied and sinks into your skin but I could definitely feel it during application. It seems to absorb reasonably fast. I’m always fighting with myself not to rush through my routine so every layer can settle. The first couple days I was less than wowed. I didn’t feel like my skin was noticeably more moisturized or glowing and even questioned if it was drying me out a little. I was wrong though, after about a week it seemed to hit its stride, maybe my skin needed more help than I realized. My face feels softer all the time now, not just after I finish moisturizing. I’m even starting to see the beginnings of the “glass skin” I keep heari

I’ve been loving this serum and applying it morning and night after cleansing and before moisturizer! The bubble texture was new to me, but it’s great and absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave a tacky film behind. I have fairly sensitive skin, and I didn’t experience any stinging or redness. One pump was enough for my face and neck, and it layered well with everything else in my routine. The bottle is generous, and based on the performance and gentle formula, it feels like a solid value for the quality. I’d consider purchasing, especially if you want vitamin C benefits without irritation!

I recently tried the Meditherapy Hyaluronic Acid Skin Booster First Serum, and this is how it went for me. The texture is extremely lightweight and absorbs almost instantly, which I appreciated. It did not leave a tacky film like some serums. After a week of use, my skin felt more comfortable and plump, especially in the morning when it is usually dull. However, while it improved hydration, I did not notice any significant reductions in deep wrinkles or dark spots during that time. Overall, this serum is a good choice if you want consistent hydration and a smooth base for your skincare routine, but if you want to see quick dramatic results, you will probably need to combine it with other products.
